task.text: Admit a burst, then a steady rate, and tell rejected callers when to come back.
Implement `TokenBucket(int capacity, double perSecond, LongSupplier nanos)` and `Limiter(int capacity, double perSecond, LongSupplier nanos)`. Time comes only from the `nanos` supplier.

items: A `TokenBucket` starts full. `long acquire()` returns `0` if a token was taken, otherwise the **milliseconds, rounded up,** until one exists.
Tokens refill lazily from elapsed time (no timer thread) and never exceed `capacity`. A rejection takes nothing.
`Limiter.acquire(String client)` gives every client its own bucket and returns the same convention.
Both must be safe to call from many threads.

checks.title: A full bucket admits a burst
Idle time never banks past capacity
Each client has its own bucket
Only the injected clock is read

hints.text: Do not run a timer. Remember how many tokens you had and when you last looked; on each call, add what the elapsed time earned, capped at capacity.

`TokenBucket` keeps `double tokens` and `long last`. `acquire` is `synchronized`: refill, then either spend 1 or compute the wait from the missing fraction. `Limiter` maps client to bucket with `computeIfAbsent`.
